   129→        `    // else 연결 노드 실행`,

   131→        `}`,

   136→        `script {`,
   137→        `  for (let ${indexName} = 0; ${indexName} < items.length; ${indexName}++) {`,

   140→        `  }`,
   141→        `}`,
   142→      ].join('\n');
   143→
   144→    case 'function':
   145→      return [
   146→        `script {`,
   147→        `  function ${funcName}(${props.params.map(safeName).join(', ')}) {`,
   148→        `    ${props.body}`,
   149→        `  }`,
   150→        `}`,
   151→      ].join('\n');
   152→
   153→    case 'map':
   154→      return [
   155→        `script {`,
   156→        `  let result = array.map(function(${itemName}) {`,
   157→        `    return ${props.expression};`,
   158→        `  });`,
   159→        `}`,
   160→      ].join('\n');
   161→
   162→    case 'filter':
   163→      return [
   164→        `script {`,
   165→        `  let result = array.filter(function(${itemName}) {`,
   166→        `    return ${props.condition};`,
   167→        `  });`,
   168→        `}`,
   169→      ].join('\n');
   170→
   171→    case 'reduce':
   172→      return [
   173→        `script {`,
   174→        `  let result = array.reduce(function(${accumName}, ${itemName}) {`,

   176→        `  }, ${props.initial});`,
   177→        `}`,

   179→

   187→ * @param {string} name
   188→ * @returns {string}
   189→ */
   190→function safeName(name) {

   192→}
   193→
